name: Ammunition (Sling): Bullet, Smoke
body:
Cost 100 gp Weight 5 lbs.
Pack Size 10

Smoke bullets require only a successful touch attack to release the smoke. When they strike a target, they burst, releasing a cloud of noxious gas that requires the creature struck to attempt a DC 13 Fortitude save. If the save fails, the target is nauseated for 2 rounds.
